messages.text: This is your Performance Charts section. It helps you compare your metrics across different time periods.
First, select what you want to analyse from this dropdown. For example Total Clicks, Orders, or other available reports.
Click Daily to see performance broken down by day.
Click Weekly to compare performance week by week.
Click Monthly to view longer term trends by month.
The blue bar on the far right shows your current selected period.
The middle grey bar shows the previous period, so you can compare directly.
The lightest bar on the left shows the period before that, helping you spot longer term trends.
